# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven to eight years old  <sub>[v1 c6 P8](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0008), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P8](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c1 P32](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0032)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair, neat, and proper little girl with gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a prim mouth. She has long, smooth, silky yellow curls that never get out of order. She is a quiet child who always looks as if she has just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P8](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0008), [v2 c1 P32](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is extraordinarily well-behaved, quiet, and obedient, behaving so primly and predictably that she is sometimes considered monotonous or boring. She is very neat, careful, and industrious, always eager to help with household chores. Unlike her twin brother, she is placid and timid, being particularly afraid of cows and ghost stories. She holds orthodox, conventional views, reciting her prayers and lessons dutifully without question.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c10 P90](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0090), [v2 c21 P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v3 c1 P34](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0034)_

## History

Dora Keith grew up in East Grafton with her sick, widowed mother, Mary Keith, and her twin brother, Davy. Following her mother's death in late autumn, Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley adopted Dora and Davy and brought them to Green Gables. Unlike her troublesome brother, Dora settled quickly into farm life, becoming a favorite helper around the house due to her neatness and reliability. She began attending Avonlea school the following autumn alongside Davy. Although she is occasionally coerced into Davy's misadventures—such as being tricked into walking a pigpen fence or skipping Sunday School—she remains a steadfast, well-behaved child.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c13 P27](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0027), [v2 c19 P1](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0001), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)_
